faq.q: Can I swim in the sea off Marbella in October 2027?
faq.a: Yes. Sea surface temperatures in October average 22°C, which is comfortable for swimming. Most charters include stops at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés where you can jump in. A light post-swim towel is advisable as air temps drop to 20°C by late afternoon.

faq.q: What is the weather like for a boat rental in Marbella in October?
faq.a: October in Marbella offers daytime highs of 24-26°C and lows of 18-20°C. You can expect around 8 hours of sunshine daily. The Levante wind (easterly) picks up to 10-15 knots in the afternoon, but the coast between Puerto Banús and Estepona remains sheltered. Rain is rare – typically only 3-4 days per month.

faq.q: Which boats are available for October 2027 charters?
faq.a: Our full fleet is available: from the 5-pax Dubhe (€749/2h) and Mariah SX21 speedboat to the 12-pax Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h), Ferretti 94, and Canados 86. All depart from Puerto Banús. Book early for the larger yachts as demand remains steady through autumn.

faq.q: Do I need to book a boat rental in Marbella in advance for October?
faq.a: Yes, we recommend booking at least 2-3 weeks ahead, especially for weekends and the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge. October is still popular for corporate events and family reunions. You can reserve via WhatsApp for any boat not listed with fixed pricing.

faq.q: What is included in the price of a Marbella boat rental in October?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed English-speaking skipper, fuel, bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra port fees or hidden costs. The Mangusta 80 also includes a jet ski free of charge.

faq.q: Can I cruise to Gibraltar or Sotogrande in October?
faq.a: Absolutely. October’s calm seas make it a great month for longer trips. From Puerto Banús, you can reach Sotogrande in about 45 minutes and Gibraltar in 1.5 hours on a planing boat like the Pershing 46 or Azimut 58. Always check the wind forecast – Levante can build in the Strait.

faq.q: What should I wear for an October boat trip in Marbella?
faq.a: Daytime: swimwear, shorts, T-shirt, sunglasses, and sunscreen (SPF 30+). Evenings: a light jumper or windbreaker as temperatures drop to 18°C after sunset. Non-slip shoes are recommended on deck. The skipper will have blankets on board for cooler moments.

faq.q: Are there any weather-related cancellations in October?
faq.a: We monitor forecasts closely. If the Levante wind exceeds 20 knots or a storm is forecast (very rare in October), we offer a full refund or reschedule at no extra cost. In practice, 95% of October charters sail as planned. Your safety is our priority.

data.body_html:
October 2027 is shaping up to be one of the best months for a Marbella boat rental weather October 2027. Sea temperatures hover at 22°C, air temps reach 25°C in the afternoon, and you get 8 hours of daily sunshine. The crowds of July and August are gone, but the water is still warm enough for swimming. Our fleet of 16 vessels – from the 5-pax Dubhe to the 29m Ferretti 94 – departs from Puerto Banús every day. Whether you want a 2-hour sunset cruise or an 8-hour run to Estepona, October delivers calm seas and reliable weather.

Below you'll find the key weather data, boat recommendations, and pricing to help you plan your Marbella boat rental this autumn.

October Weather in Marbella: What to Expect

October is the sweet spot of the Costa del Sol autumn. Average high: 25°C. Average low: 18°C. Sea temperature: 22°C. Rainfall: only 35mm across the month (3-4 rainy days). Wind: predominantly Levante (easterly) at 10-15 knots, which creates a gentle swell but rarely disrupts cruising. The sun rises around 07:30 and sets at 19:30, giving you a full window for day trips. Morning departures are typically glassy calm; the breeze picks up after 14:00, perfect for sailing or planing back to port.

Best Boats for October Charters

For small groups (up to 5 pax), the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are nimble options for a quick spin to Cala del Faro. Both are priced at €749 for 2 hours including skipper and drinks. For 6-8 pax, the Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) or Red Tide (11m, 6 pax) offer more deck space. Mid-sized groups (10-12 pax) should consider the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) or the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) which includes a free jet ski. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

Where to Cruise in October

With stable weather, you have plenty of options. A classic half-day route: Puerto Banús → Cala Cortés (swim stop) → Marbella Marina → Cabopino. For a full day, push south to Estepona (30 min) or Sotogrande (45 min). The Pershing 46 and Azimut 58 can reach Gibraltar in 1.5 hours. The sheltered bay at Cala del Faro is a favourite for lunch anchoring. Evening charters are also popular – the sunset over La Concha mountain is spectacular from the water.

What's Included in Every Charter

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden taxes

Booking Tips for October 2027

Demand remains steady through October, especially for weekends and the Mangusta 80. We recommend booking at least 2-3 weeks in advance. For boats without fixed pricing (e.g., Ferretti 94, Canados 86, K80), contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. All charters are private – you won't share the boat with strangers. Cancellations due to adverse weather (wind >20 knots or storms) are fully refundable.
